turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Did anyone hear Owen before that zero went in?
Can I ask something off the record?
Nothing in this room is off the record. Was Owen heard first, yes or no?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned here. What do you actually have on that essay?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
My son is not a cheater, and you've now said so without a single document. Say one more word about my family and we finish this in the principal's office.
